name: Timeguessr Club — automatic receipts
summary: Automatically save completed Timeguessr games and picture stats to your friends’ scoreboard.
description:
Finish a game. Let the extension report the damage.

Timeguessr Club automatically imports completed daily and non-daily Timeguessr games into your friends’ shared scoreboard, including all five picture scores, year errors and distances.

• Sign in with your invitation-only tracker account.
• Automatically save completed games, with offline retries.
• Keep existing scores safe: conflicting entries require manual review.
• Compare wins and points, per-game averages and the hall of shame on the scoreboard.
• Pause imports or sign out whenever you want.

A Timeguessr Club account is required; ask your club administrator for an invitation. This extension is designed for the scoreboard at https://albertcintas.github.io/timeguessr-tracker/. It is not a general-purpose Timeguessr account sync tool.

Independent companion project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Timeguessr. Free to use, with no ads or analytics.
